sentences.text: Es de noche.
sentences.english: It is night.

sentences.text: Nico no puede dormir, y sale al patio.
sentences.english: Nico cannot sleep, and he goes out to the patio.

sentences.text: Doña Marta está allí, cerca del árbol.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is there, near the tree.

sentences.text: Sam también está en el patio.
sentences.english: Sam is in the patio too.

sentences.text: La luna es blanca y las estrellas son muchas.
sentences.english: The moon is white and the stars are many.

sentences.text: —Abuela, ¿me contás un cuento? —dice Nico.
sentences.english: "Grandma, will you tell me a story?" says Nico.

sentences.text: —Está bien, pero es un cuento de mi vida, no es un cuento de animales.
sentences.english: "All right, but it is a story from my life, not a story about animals."

sentences.text: Doña Marta mira a Nico un momento y habla.
sentences.english: Doña Marta looks at Nico for a moment and speaks.

sentences.text: —Cuando yo era niña, mi abuelo tenía una finca.
sentences.english: "When I was a girl, my grandfather had a farm.

sentences.text: Todos los años, mi tío Rafael celebraba su cumpleaños en noviembre.
sentences.english: Every year, my uncle Rafael celebrated his birthday in November."

sentences.text: Mi cumpleaños era en febrero, el de mi hermano Mario era en abril y el de mi tía Carmen era en junio.
sentences.english: "My birthday was in February, my brother Mario's was in April and my aunt Carmen's was in June."

sentences.text: Pero la fiesta de noviembre era la más grande.
sentences.english: But the November party was the biggest.

sentences.text: Mi tío invitaba a toda la familia, y todos íbamos a la finca.
sentences.english: My uncle invited the whole family, and we all went to the farm.

sentences.text: Mi tío no tenía mucho dinero.
sentences.english: My uncle did not have much money.

sentences.text: No era fácil conseguir chamba en el pueblo.
sentences.english: It was not easy to get work in the village.

sentences.text: Pero siempre estaba contento.
sentences.english: But he was always cheerful.

sentences.text: Por la tarde había un culto con alabanza, ofrenda y himnos.
sentences.english: In the afternoon there was a service with praise, offering and hymns.

sentences.text: Después había tamales, café y pan.
sentences.english: Afterwards there were tamales, coffee and bread.

sentences.text: Yo estaba muy contenta.
sentences.english: I was very happy.

sentences.text: Cantábamos y cantábamos.
sentences.english: We sang and sang.

sentences.text: —Una noche, mi hermano Mario y yo volvíamos a la casa con mi tío.
sentences.english: "One night, my brother Mario and I were going back to the house with my uncle."

sentences.text: En la finca no había luz en la calle.
sentences.english: On the farm there was no light in the street.

sentences.text: Pero la noche era bonita.
sentences.english: But the night was beautiful.

sentences.text: La luna era grande y blanca, y las estrellas eran como flores blancas.
sentences.english: The moon was big and white, and the stars were like white flowers.

sentences.text: Entonces la luna cambió.
sentences.english: Then the moon changed.

sentences.text: Ya no era blanca: era roja.
sentences.english: It was no longer white: it was red.

sentences.text: La oscuridad llegó a la calle.
sentences.english: The darkness came to the street.

sentences.text: Ya no veíamos la tierra.
sentences.english: We could no longer see the ground.

sentences.text: Mario abrió los ojos y la boca.
sentences.english: Mario opened his eyes and his mouth.

sentences.text: No quería caminar.
sentences.english: He did not want to walk.

sentences.text: Yo pensé: «Esto no es bueno».
sentences.english: I thought: "This is not good."

sentences.text: Tenía las manos frías.
sentences.english: My hands were cold.

sentences.text: Mi tío Rafael era alto y delgado, pero era muy amable.
sentences.english: My uncle Rafael was tall and thin, but he was very kind.

sentences.text: Él dijo: —No pasa nada.
sentences.english: He said: "Nothing is wrong.

sentences.text: La luna cambia esta noche, pero va a volver.
sentences.english: The moon is changing tonight, but it will come back."

sentences.text: —Miren las estrellas —dijo—.
sentences.english: "Look at the stars," he said.

sentences.text: Son más bonitas en la oscuridad.
sentences.english: "They are more beautiful in the dark."

sentences.text: —Mario ya no estaba triste.
sentences.english: "Mario was no longer sad.

sentences.text: Mi tío dijo que íbamos a jugar un juego.
sentences.english: My uncle said we were going to play a game."

sentences.text: —El que ve más estrellas gana —dijo mi tío.
sentences.english: "Whoever sees more stars wins," my uncle said.

sentences.text: Miramos y miramos.
sentences.english: We looked and looked.

sentences.text: Yo veía doce, y Mario veía quince.
sentences.english: I saw twelve, and Mario saw fifteen.

sentences.text: Mario ganó.
sentences.english: Mario won.

sentences.text: Pero yo pensaba en las estrellas: parecían las luces de un pueblo grande.
sentences.english: But I was thinking about the stars: they looked like the lights of a big town.

sentences.text: Mi tío cantó una canción, y todos cantamos con él.
sentences.english: My uncle sang a song, and we all sang with him.

sentences.text: Caminamos y caminamos.
sentences.english: We walked and walked.

sentences.text: Escuchamos las vacas en la finca, y escuchamos un perro.
sentences.english: We heard the cows on the farm, and we heard a dog.

sentences.text: El perro era negro y feo, pero simpático.
sentences.english: The dog was black and ugly, but friendly.

sentences.text: Parecía un caballo pequeño.
sentences.english: He looked like a small horse.

sentences.text: Él vino a buscarnos en la oscuridad y caminó con nosotros hasta la casa de mi tía Carmen.
sentences.english: He came to look for us in the dark and walked with us to my aunt Carmen's house.

sections.title: La casa de la tía Carmen

sentences.text: —La casa de mi tía estaba limpia y bonita.
sentences.english: "My aunt's house was clean and beautiful.

sentences.text: Las paredes eran blancas, el techo era rojo y el piso era de tierra.
sentences.english: The walls were white, the roof was red and the floor was earth."

sentences.text: En el jardín había flores azules, y los árboles eran verdes.
sentences.english: In the garden there were blue flowers, and the trees were green.

sentences.text: También había gallinas y una pelota vieja.
sentences.english: There were also hens and an old ball.

sentences.text: La luna volvió a ser blanca.
sentences.english: The moon became white again.

sentences.text: Mario y yo dormimos muy bien.
sentences.english: Mario and I slept very well.

sentences.text: —Hoy hay luz en todo el país.
sentences.english: "Today there is light all over the country.

sentences.text: Es un cambio bueno, y el pueblo también cambió.
sentences.english: It is a good change, and the village changed too."

sentences.text: En la calle donde caminábamos entonces, hay casas y tiendas.
sentences.english: On the street where we used to walk then, there are houses and shops.

sentences.text: La comunidad quiere construir más, y el gobierno quiere mejorar el país.
sentences.english: The community wants to build more, and the government wants to improve the country.

sentences.text: En agosto y en septiembre, la gente celebra.
sentences.english: In August and September, people celebrate.

sentences.text: Yo celebro con ellos, pero nunca olvido la luna roja.
sentences.english: I celebrate with them, but I never forget the red moon.

sentences.text: —¿Y la luna volvió? —dice Nico.
sentences.english: "And did the moon come back?" says Nico.

sentences.text: —Sí, mi niño.
sentences.english: "Yes, my boy.

sentences.text: Volvió blanca, como hoy.
sentences.english: It came back white, like today."

sentences.text: —Yo quiero ganar mañana —dice Nico, y abre los ojos de nuevo—.
sentences.english: "I want to win tomorrow," says Nico, and he opens his eyes again.

sentences.text: ¿Y el perro negro?
sentences.english: "And the black dog?"

sentences.text: —Era un perro muy bueno, y parecía un caballo —dice doña Marta.
sentences.english: "He was a very good dog, and he looked like a horse," says doña Marta.

sentences.text: Nico abre la boca para hablar, pero ya duerme.
sentences.english: Nico opens his mouth to speak, but he is already asleep.

sentences.text: Sam escucha y piensa: «Quiero recordar este cuento».
sentences.english: Sam listens and thinks: "I want to remember this story."

sentences.text: Doña Marta mira la luna.
sentences.english: Doña Marta looks at the moon.

sentences.text: —Es hora de dormir, Sam.
sentences.english: "It is time to sleep, Sam.

sentences.text: Mañana es domingo, y vamos a ir al culto.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is Sunday, and we are going to the service."
